 Aries Shani Horoscope Today, 27 October 2026: Krittika Moon on your ruler’s Mangalvar sharpens focus, so channel anger into work 
 Trending Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Career Horoscope Love Horoscope Today Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Career Horoscope Love Horoscope Today Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Career Horoscope Love Horoscope Today Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Aries Shani Horoscope Today, 27 October 2026: Krittika Moon on your ruler’s Mangalvar sharpens focus, so channel anger into work 
 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Oct 27, 2026, 01:15 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Tuesday belongs to Mars, the ruler of Aries, and the Moon moves through Krittika, a nakshatra known for sharp, cutting focus. Krittika is ruled by the Sun and presided over by Agni, the deity of fire. Early in the day, the Moon passes from Aries into Taurus, your second house, while staying in this nakshatra. With Mars debilitated in Cancer, your fourth, irritation can rise quickly, so the task is to turn that energy into work. Shani stays retrograde in your twelfth. Krittika’s Sharp Focus
 Krittika’s symbol is a blade, which suits cutting away distractions. Choose the one task that matters most this week and give it uninterrupted hours. Turn off notifications and close extra tabs. Focus comes easily today if you protect it. Mars Day and Channelling Anger
 Mars rules your sign, and on its own weekday, its energy runs strong even in debilitation. Small irritations at home, such as an untidy room or a delayed meal, may trigger impatience. Instead of reacting, put the energy into a practical job, like clearing a backlog of files or repairing something at home. A brisk walk before work also takes the edge off. Moon Enters the Second
 Once the Moon reaches Taurus, your second house of speech and money, words carry weight. Krittika can make speech sharp, so soften feedback to colleagues and family. Exalted Jupiter in your fourth keeps the home peaceful if you stay calm. Partners and Shani
 Your seventh still holds the weak Sun with two retrograde planets. Avoid venting work frustration on your partner. Retrograde Shani in your twelfth asks for rest after a productive day. Do’s for Today
 Give the most important task uninterrupted hours. Take a brisk walk before work. Don’ts for Today
 Avoid reacting to small irritations at home. Do not vent work stress on your partner. Shani Remedy for Today
 Recite the Bajrang Baan on Tuesday evening. Donate a pair of safety goggles to a welder.
